career_ladder.note: Career progression for engineering cadres in Bihar State Power Holding Company Limited (BSPHCL) and its subsidiary companies (NBPDCL, SBPDCL, BSPTCL, BSPGCL). Junior Engineers advance through executive engineering hierarchies to Chief Engineer level based on merit, departmental examinations, and length of service.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted through a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) comprising 100 objective questions (60 domain engineering questions + 40 non-technical questions across GK, Reasoning, Hindi, English, and Basic Computers) over 90 minutes. No interview is conducted; final selection is based strictly on CBT merit score.

stages.source_label: BSPHCL Employment Notice No. 02/2024 Examination Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: Technical Engineering Syllabus (Diploma standard in Electrical or Civil Engineering)
papers.negative_marking: As per CBT notification rules; 1 mark per question
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying threshold: UR 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/Female 32%

papers.paper_name: Non-Technical Domain: General Knowledge (10), Reasoning (10), General Hindi (10), English (5), Computers (5)
papers.negative_marking: As per CBT notification rules; 1 mark per question
papers.qualifying_threshold: Total aggregate marks (Technical + Non-Technical out of 100) determines final merit

financial_package.note: Candidates are placed on a consolidated monthly stipend (₹25,900 to ₹38,900) during the initial one-year training/probation period. Upon successful completion of probation, regular pay is fixed in Level 8 (Entry Basic ₹47,600, corresponding to pre-revised Grade Pay ₹4,800) with full state enterprise allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: BSPHCL Employment Notice No. 02/2024 for Junior Electrical Engineer (GTO) & JE (Civil)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 8 entry basic pay of ₹47,600 with standard 58% DA (₹27,608), HRA (8% to 16% depending on posting in Patna HQ, grid substations, or circle offices: ₹3,808 to ₹7,616), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), and special power corporation allowances. In-hand reflects statutory 10% EPF/NPS deduction on Basic+DA (₹7,521), electricity recovery, and professional tax.
official_perks: Company designated quarters in thermal power stations / grid substation colonies or HRA up to 16%
Subsidized electricity allowance as per Bihar state power utility rules
Medical reimbursement and comprehensive health coverage for self and dependents
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF) / NPS with matching employer contribution
Technical field inspection allowance and mobile phone reimbursement
Gratuity and group accidental insurance cover for power station and line duty
